badges.line: You live on both sides of this one. Which side shows up depends on the moment.

halves.name: Old Soul
halves.desc: You love the cozy, familiar kind of life, you speak gently, and you still need hours alone behind your own door. Quiet is where you recharge.

axes.line: You love hard and keep your own door. Close still means space.
You hold the person first. The hard part waits for a gentler moment.
Traditions, rituals and the way a home should run feel like home to you.

halves.name: The Calm One
halves.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You take each day as it comes, you keep your favorites close, and you're usually the calmest person in the room.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

stings: People read your quiet as distance, and you've never corrected them.
People mistake your calm for not caring. You just haven't found what's worth rushing for.
hearts: Love with a little space is still deep love.
My life doesn't need a progress bar.

tags.name: Fair to everyone
tags.heart: Fair isn't cold to me. It's safe.
tags.sting: You trust the process because you don't quite trust people to wing it.

youToldGenii.said: Zero. The syllabus doesn't read reviews.
"Buyer one was first. I'm really sorry."

tags.name: Keeps family traditions
tags.heart: I can hold new ideas and old wishes at the same time.
tags.sting: You're open-minded about everyone's setup, and part of you still wants the one you grew up with.

youToldGenii.said: Said "in this house, we..." and heard my parent's voice
Kept a rule from my childhood home, like shoes off
"Forever. I'm even keeping the tablecloth with the gravy stain."

tags.name: Work stays at work
tags.heart: A good life is the whole point, not the reward for later.
tags.sting: You turned down the bigger role and slept great. Some people still can't figure you out.

youToldGenii.said: Closed the place down with them.
Never. Low likes stay up, like a monument.
Sleep through it. Every week. No regrets.

tags.name: Puts feelings into words
tags.heart: If I feel it, you're going to read it.
tags.sting: You pour it all into the message. The practical help shows up later.

youToldGenii.said: Sent a wall of caps and too many exclamation marks.
Sent a long message about how much they matter
$50 on ten perfect words. Worth every cent.

tags.name: First to help family
tags.heart: When my people need someone, I want it to be me.
tags.sting: You're everyone's plan B, and your own plan A keeps moving to next month.

youToldGenii.said: Said yes before they finished the sentence.
Hand them a real key. Stay as long as it takes.
Return all 23 by Sunday. This is my calling now.

calls.line: You've read the terms and conditions on something.
You still make the family recipe exactly as written.
You'll leave on time today and not think about work or school once.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Advocate: "The family with the baby gets one first."’ Last time, you did: ‘Page 12. I had it bookmarked.’
